faqs.a: All professionals undergo a rigorous check including ID verification, real-time face scan and background checks to ensure maximum safety.

faqs.q: Do I pay to request quotes?
faqs.a: No. Searching and contacting professionals is free for clients. You negotiate the price directly with the professional.

faqs.q: As a professional, how do I receive requests?
faqs.a: After completing ID upload and face scan, your profile becomes visible to thousands of local clients. You receive instant notifications and communicate directly with clients.

faqs.q: Is there a mandatory subscription for professionals?
faqs.a: There is no mandatory subscription to start receiving contacts on the platform.
